content: Swarmpit 1.9 config env: SWARMPIT_DOCKER_SOCK, SWARMPIT_DOCKER_API (default 1.30), SWARMPIT_DOCKER_HTTP_TIMEOUT, SWARMPIT_DB, SWARMPIT_INFLUXDB (default nil), SWARMPIT_AGENT_URL, SWARMPIT_WORKDIR. db/init runs influx wait+init only when (influx-configured?) i.e. SWARMPIT_INFLUXDB set; stats persist to influx only when configured, otherwise in-memory cache fed by swarmpit/agent. Autoredeploy is an in-app http-kit scheduled job every 60s comparing registry digests (agent.clj) and does not use influx or the agent service. Swarmpit 1.10 tagged 2026-03-04 (docker-api default 1.44). Docker Engine 29.0-29.2 raised min API to 1.44; 29.3 lowered default min to 1.40; DOCKER_MIN_API_VERSION override.
